steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Select RFQ and save the option to partially award the event to multiple vendors.
Verify that saving the configuration closes the Configuration for Event window.
Provide the required event title so the event can be published and found in the list.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Complete the RFQ pricing sheet for the added product.
Add the product-provided vendor audience required for publishing.
Publish the configured event so it is available in the events list.
Confirm that publishing reached the event project page.
Return to the events list to verify the created event there.
Confirm that the events list rendered without an error.
Verify that the configured event appears in the events list.
